checks.description: Todos los workflows de tablero declaran permissions: {} en la raíz
checks.cmd: for f in .github/workflows/*.yml; do [ "$(yq '.permissions | (tag == "!!map" and length == 0)' "$f")" = true ] || echo "$f"; done

checks.description: Cada job de cada workflow declara sus propios permissions
Solo escriben codeql (security-events), images (packages), labeler y pr-report (pull-requests) y nightly (actions); ningún write-all ni read-all
checks.cmd: grep -rlE 'permissions: *(write|read)-all' .github/workflows; yq -N '.jobs | to_entries | .[] | .value.permissions // {} | to_entries | .[] | select(.value == "write") | (filename | sub(".*/"; "")) + ":" + .key' .github/workflows/*.yml | sort -u | tr '\n' ' '

checks.description: Ningún run ni script de github-script contiene una expresión ${{ }}: todo dato llega por env
codeql.yml analiza el lenguaje actions con init y analyze en un job con security-events: write
checks.cmd: yq '[.jobs[] | select(.permissions."security-events" == "write") | .steps[] | select(.uses // "" | test("^github/codeql-action/(init|analyze)@"))] | "languages=" + ([.[] | select(.with.languages) | .with.languages] | join(",")) + " steps=" + (length | tostring)' .github/workflows/codeql.yml

checks.description: Code scanning tiene análisis de CodeQL y ninguna alerta abierta
labeler.yml se dispara con pull_request_target, no hace checkout y usa actions/labeler fijada por SHA
checks.cmd: yq '"trigger=" + (.on | keys | join(",")) + " checkout=" + ([.jobs[].steps[] | select(.uses // "" | test("^actions/checkout@"))] | length | tostring) + " labeler=" + ([.jobs[].steps[] | select(.uses // "" | test("^actions/labeler@[0-9a-f]{40}$"))] | length | tostring)' .github/workflows/labeler.yml

checks.description: Al menos un pull request de tablero tiene una etiqueta api, web o ci puesta por labeler
checks.cmd: gh pr list --state all --limit 50 --json labels --jq '[.[].labels[].name | select(. == "api" or . == "web" or . == "ci")] | length'

checks.description: pr-report.yml se dispara al terminar ci-web, solo actúa si el run vino de un pull_request, no hace checkout y descarga el artefacto de ese run
checks.cmd: yq '"from=" + (.on.workflow_run.workflows | join(",")) + " guard=" + ([.jobs[] | select(.if // "" | test("workflow_run.event == .pull_request."))] | length | tostring) + " checkout=" + ([.jobs[].steps[] | select(.uses // "" | test("^actions/checkout@"))] | length | tostring) + " run-id=" + ([.jobs[].steps[] | select(.with."run-id" // "" | test("workflow_run.id"))] | length | tostring)' .github/workflows/pr-report.yml

checks.description: github-actions[bot] ha comentado el informe de web/dist en un pull request de tablero
checks.cmd: gh api 'repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/comments?sort=created&direction=desc&per_page=100' --jq '[.[] | select(.user.login == "github-actions[bot]" and (.body | test("web/dist")))] | length'

checks.description: tablero exige aprobación para los workflows de todos los colaboradores externos
dependabot.yml vigila github-actions en la raíz, uv en /api y npm (pnpm) en /web
Cada ecosistema de dependabot.yml espera al menos 7 días antes de proponer una versión nueva
El job zizmor de lint-workflows.yml corre las auditorías online con el GITHUB_TOKEN
checks.cmd: yq '.jobs[].steps[] | select(.run // "" | test("^zizmor ")) | "offline=" + (.run | test("--offline|--no-online-audits") | tostring) + " token=" + ((.env.GH_TOKEN // "") != "" | tostring)' .github/workflows/lint-workflows.yml

checks.description: Los workflows y dependabot.yml de tablero pasan actionlint y zizmor con las auditorías online sin hallazgos
Toda uses remota de los workflows de tablero está fijada por SHA de 40 caracteres con el tag en comentario
ci, ci-api, ci-web, lint-workflows y codeql terminan en success sobre el último commit de main
checks.cmd: git fetch -q origin main && sha=$(git rev-parse origin/main) && for w in ci ci-api ci-web lint-workflows codeql; do printf '%s=%s ' "$w" "$(gh run list --workflow $w.yml --commit "$sha" --json conclusion --jq '.[0].conclusion')"; done
